items.headline: Gold Steady as Rate-Hike Bets Ease, Oil Pushes Yields Higher | Stock Market News
items.summary: (Bloomberg) -- Gold was little changed as traders weighed easing bets on an imminent Federal Reserve rate hike against a surge in oil prices that pushed Treasury yields higher. Bullion traded near $4,170 an ounce, after rising 1.6% Thursday, the most in more than two weeks.

items.headline: Seven companies report earnings tomorrow, led by steel and regional banks
items.summary: Two tariff-era steelmakers and three regional banks report inside one session, making tomorrow the cleanest read yet on whether steel pricing and credit quality are holding up. Cleveland-Cliffs $CLF and Fifth Third $FITB report tomorrow before the open.

items.headline: BOJ chief says underlying inflation 'quite close' to price goal
items.summary: TOKYO, Oct 19 (Reuters) - Bank of Japan Governor Kazuo Ueda said on Monday underlying inflation is "quite close" to the central bank's 2% target with strong global AI demand adding to inflationary pressure from a tight job market.
